1911
FATHER SOLANUS NOTEBOOK NO. 12
Page 4 Cont.
Feb. 2nd New Cassocks (red) used first time. For same Wm Harri- gan gave $15.00 Mrs. M. Reade $5.00 Same confusion in distributing the candles after Mass.
Feb. 25 Sick-call (Miss Hoctor 11.30P.M. night before) at 2:30 A.M. Rev P. Bruno brings Holy Viaticum, etc. to Mrs. Julia Murphy . Trolley turns back from Park Ave and Shonard PL. and brings them to Roberts Ave.
Feb. 26 E. Fitzsp. served alone. G. Gorman failed to show up.
Feb. 28 Funeral of Julia Murphy Fr. Solanus forgot surplice for semetary, Geo Gorman huslled to Mr. Frey's got key for chapel- and surplice
Page 5 March 16 8P.M. Father Heafy holds services and speaks in hon. St. Patrick - 1st Coll. for new church about $30.00
March 19 Fr. Solanus took off his glasses to read office of St. Joseph (after a novena) and left them off. Deo Gratias!
=
28 Funeral of Tho's Carey - F. McCreedy, G. Gorman, W.Nolan and J. Fitzpat. went to Semitary with Fr. Solanus (P.M. Fr. Solanus shot to scare a dog away from stable and sadly wounded the poor creature.)
April 2nd Very Rev. Fr. Antonine begins visitation (Monday A.M. ) Closes it following Friday Eve.
April 7 Rev. Fr. Stephen arrives at 11.45 P.M. having left Pitt St. after his sermon to attend Ken. Callan who died at 4 A.M. the following day.
Apr. 10 Funeral and (Low) Mass for same Fr. Solanus with C. Nolan, B. Landy and G. Gorman went to New Rochell Semetary of the Resurrection.
Apr. 9 Palm Sunday at 5 o'cl A.M. 5 inches of snow to be plowed of side walks was all gone before evening.
